overall_notes: The paper focuses on entity extraction framed as template generation using sequence-to-sequence models. While it generates text (templates), the primary focus is on information extraction rather than natural language generation in the traditional sense. All evaluations are automatic using entity-focused metrics like CEAF-REE and F1 scores. The extraction quality was good overall.
